$comment: Elements diagram export format. Two document types: map.json (root metadata) and level files (1.json, 1.1.json, etc.). The importer picks fields by an explicit allowlist; unknown/extra fields are silently ignored.

map.title: map.json: root metadata for the exported zip

name.description: Display name shown in the Elements UI. Validated on import.

description.description: Optional free-text description of the map's purpose.

type.description: 'upn' for process maps (UPN/swimlane). 'architecture' for interaction-flow / architecture diagrams. Must match the subtype family of the level files.

level.title: Level file: one per diagram level (1.json, 1.1.json, …)
level.$comment: The importer picks fields by an allowlist (see each element $def's $comment for its allowlist location). Fields not on the allowlist are preserved in the export but ignored on import.

name.description: Display name of this diagram level. For child levels this should match the drilldown title on the parent activity.

description.description: Optional description of this level's scope.

levelNumber.description: Hierarchical level identifier. Must exactly match the filename (e.g. '1.3' → file is '1.3.json'). Determines parent/child relationships: level '1.3' is the child of activity number=3 in level '1'.

topLevel.description: True only for the root level (levelNumber '1'). Exactly one level in the zip must have topLevel: true.

subtype.description: Diagram subtype. All levels in a zip should use the same subtype family. See references/diagram-types.md for what each subtype is for and the drilldown rules between them.

state.description: Workflow state at export time (e.g. 'draft'). Preserved verbatim; ignored by importer.

theme.description: MongoDB ObjectId of the team theme. Preserved verbatim; importer substitutes the target team's theme.

activities.description: Process steps / nodes on this diagram level.

flowlines.description: Directed connectors between activities or swimlines.

swimlines.description: Pool/swimlane structure. Present even when empty ({lines:[]}).

notes.description: Sticky note elements placed on the canvas.

texts.description: Free-text label elements placed on the canvas.

images.description: Diagram-level images placed on the canvas (not activity images).

activity.title: Activity: a process step or node
activity.$comment: Importer field allowlist for activity: see references/editing-guide.md -> Importer Allowlist.

mxKey.description: Canvas element ID, 0-1000000. Unique across ALL element types within this level (activities, flowlines, swimlines, texts, notes, images share the same mxKey space). See references/editing-workflow.md → mxKey uniqueness.

number.description: Activity sequence number within this level, 1-999. Also determines the child drilldown level: an activity with number=3 in level '1' drills down to level '1.3'. Must be unique within the level.

text.description:
Activity label. May contain HTML (e.g.
,
, ). This is the canonical value; strippedText is derived from it.

strippedText.description: Plain-text version of 'text' with all HTML tags removed. Ignored by the importer but kept in sync for search indexing. Must equal strip_html(text).

customStyle.description: If true, the 'style' object is applied. If false, the default theme style is used and 'style' is ignored by the importer.

style.description: Full style override. Only applied by the importer when customStyle: true. Preserve verbatim when editing existing activities.

container.description: Whether this activity acts as a container for other elements. Ignored by importer; preserved in export.

locked.description: Whether the element is locked for editing in the UI. Ignored by importer.

attributePadding.description: UI layout hint. Ignored by importer.

footerText.description: Optional footer text shown below the activity box.

resourcesPerRow.description: How many resource icons to show per row in the activity. Optional.

attributes.description: Freeform key/value metadata displayed on the activity (e.g. Salesforce execution order).

mxKey.description: Unique within this activity's attributes array (not the global mxKey space).

resources.description: People, systems, or objects linked to this activity.

attachments.description: URL, image, or text note attachments. Importer re-creates these; see attachment sub-types.

drilldowns.description: Non-empty array signals that this activity has a child level. Child level filename = parentLevelNumber + '.' + activity.number + '.json'. The importer only checks for non-empty; targetDbId and title are display metadata.

targetDbId.description: DB reference to child diagram. Remapped on import; any non-empty string is fine in a modified export.

title.description: Display name of the child level. Should match the child level's 'name' field.

image.description: UUID referencing an image file bundled in the zip at 'diagram/activity/{uuid}'. Omit if no activity image.

flowline.title: Flowline: directed connector between two elements
flowline.$comment: Importer field allowlist for flowline: see references/editing-guide.md -> Importer Allowlist.

mxKey.description: Canvas element ID. Must be unique across all element types in this level.

text.description: Label shown on the flowline. May contain HTML.

strippedText.description: Plain-text version of text. Ignored by importer but kept in sync.

srcId.description: mxKey of the source element. Must reference an existing activity or swimline mxKey in this level.

tgtId.description: mxKey of the target element. Must reference an existing activity or swimline mxKey in this level.

srcPosition.description: Override for the connection exit point on the source. Null uses the default anchor.

tgtPosition.description: Override for the connection entry point on the target. Null uses the default anchor.

customStyle.description: Whether a custom style object is applied.

style.description: Custom line style. Only used when customStyle: true.

flForm.description: Arrow/line form descriptor. Preserve verbatim when present.

waypoints.description: Manual routing waypoints [{x, y}]. Null or [] for auto-routed.

lineTexts.description: Additional label segments on the flowline.

connector.description: Cross-level connector links. 'links' array is cleared on import; preserve for export fidelity.

terminator.description: End-point terminator configuration. Preserve verbatim when present.

position.description: Overall pool bounding box {x, y, w, h}.

horizontal.description: 0 = lanes stacked top-to-bottom as horizontal bands (the usual UPN layout). 1 = lanes side-by-side as vertical columns. Native exports emit 0/1.

swimline_line.title: Swimline: a single lane within the pool
swimline_line.$comment: Importer field allowlist for swimline: see references/editing-guide.md -> Importer Allowlist.

mxKey.description: Canvas element ID. Must be unique across all element types in this level. Flowlines can use this as srcId or tgtId with srcType/tgtType: 'swimline'.

text.description: Lane label shown in the header strip.

note.title: Note: sticky note element
note.$comment: Importer field allowlist for note: see references/editing-guide.md -> Importer Allowlist.

mxKey.description: Canvas element ID, unique within the level.

paperClass.description: Visual colour/style class for the note.

text_element.title: Text: free-text label on canvas
text_element.$comment: Importer field allowlist for text element: see references/editing-guide.md -> Importer Allowlist.

mxKey.description: Canvas element ID, unique within the level.

strippedText.description: Plain-text version. Kept in sync; ignored by importer.

style.description: Custom text style. Used when customStyle: true.

diagram_image.title: Diagram image: an image placed on the canvas (not an activity image)
diagram_image.$comment: Importer field allowlist for diagram image: see references/editing-guide.md -> Importer Allowlist.

mxKey.description: Canvas element ID, unique within the level.

uuid.description: References image file at 'diagram/{uuid}' inside the zip.

copyImage.description: Whether the image is a copy vs original reference.

deleted.description: Soft-delete flag. Ignored by importer but present in exports.

interaction.title: Interaction: message indicator anchored to a flowline

flowlineMxKey.description: mxKey of the flowline this interaction is attached to.

resource.title: Resource: person, system, or object linked to an activity
resource.$comment: Importer field allowlist for resource: see references/editing-guide.md -> Importer Allowlist. Matched to the team resource library by (name, type) case-insensitive.

mxKey.description: Position index of this resource on the activity, 1-999. Unique within the activity's resources array (a separate space from the level's mxKey space).

name.description: Resource name. Matched case-insensitively to the target team's resource library on import.

type.description: Resource category. Used together with 'name' for library lookup.

hidden.description: Whether the resource icon is hidden on the activity.

main.description: Whether this is the primary resource. Not in importer allowlist; preserved for export fidelity.

position.description: Position of the resource icon relative to the activity.

rasci.description: RASCI role flags for this resource on this activity.

resourceDbId.description: MongoDB ObjectId of the resource in the source team. Ignored by importer (resource matched by name+type). Safe to set to any non-empty string for new resources.

system.description: True for built-in system resources. Not in importer allowlist; preserved for export fidelity.

iconKey.description: S3 icon key for custom resource icons. Null for resources without a custom icon.

element_position.title: Position: bounding box for a canvas element

x.description: Canvas x coordinate. No enforced bounds; inspect neighbouring elements to avoid overlap.

y.description: Canvas y coordinate. No enforced bounds; inspect neighbouring elements to avoid overlap.

w.description: Element width. Typical activity: 180. Required for activities.

h.description: Element height. Typical activity: 120–150. Required for activities.

rotation.description: Rotation in degrees. Omit or 0 for no rotation.

activity_style.title: Activity style: full visual override (used when customStyle: true)

iconColor.description: Hex colour for resource icon tinting.

numberColor.description: Hex colour for the number badge background.

numberIconColor.description: Hex colour for the number badge text.

underlineColor.description: Hex colour for the bottom underline stripe.

horizontal.description: 1 = header is at top, 0 = header is at left.

header_data.title: Header / legend configuration for the diagram

color.description: Hex theme colour for the header bar.

legendItems.description: Legend entries shown at the bottom of the diagram.
